# wowsims links (4 November 2026)

The final set of each spec, with enchants and consumables (the "Both" column of README.md). The full wowsims test raid buffs and debuffs, a level 63 boss, 2 min. Open a link, then select Simulate. The DPS values come from wowsims master commit `8298ab833` (4 November 2026). A later wowsims version can give a different DPS.

| Spec | DPS (8298ab833) | Link |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fury Warrior | 839.2 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/warrior/dps/#) |
| Combat Rogue | 671.6 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/rogue/dps/#) |
| Hunter | 855.6 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/hunter/dps/#) |
| Fire Mage | 823.9 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/mage/dps/#) |
| Demonology Warlock | 856.3 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/warlock/dps/#) |
| Retribution | 908.3 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/paladin/retribution/#) |

`zzlink_main.go` makes these links (copy to `cmd/zzlink/main.go`). It also decodes each link and runs it again as a check. The check on commit 8298ab833 gives the same values ±0.1%.

The links of 2 November (commit 895cd67f9) had the same items. Only the consumables changed: the shared elixir list takes the elixirs of the new Warlock preset.
